name: scratchwork
description: Scratchwork — the single-file Markdown renderer (renderer/) and the scratchwork dev CLI (cli/).

scripts.build: cd renderer && bun install && cd ../cli && bun run build
scripts.build:renderer: cd renderer && bun install && bun run build
scripts.check: cd cli && bun run check && cd ../server && bun run check
scripts.test: cd renderer && bun test && cd ../cli && bun run test
scripts.typecheck: cd cli && bun run typecheck && cd ../server && bun run typecheck && cd ../deploy/generic-aws && bun run typecheck && cd ../local-dev && bun run typecheck && cd ../sndbx.sh && bun run typecheck
